The task cannot be completed as specified. VS Code does not include Arabic as a built-in display language. The available built-in languages are: English, Chinese (Simplified), Japanese, Spanish, Portuguese (Brasil), Russian, Korean, French, German, Chinese (Traditional), Italian, Polish, Czech, Hungarian, Bulgarian, and Turkish.

To use Arabic in VS Code, you would need to install the Arabic Language Pack extension from the VS Code Extensions marketplace. However, since your requirement explicitly states "without using any extensions," changing the display language to Arabic is not possible in the current configuration.
